description.everlastingwinter: Forces continuous snowfall and allows snow layers to accumulate.
text.autoconfig.everlastingwinter.title: Everlasting Winter
text.autoconfig.everlastingwinter.option: Constant Snowfall
Enables constant snowfall in the specified biomes.
Snow Height Limit
Maximum total snow height in eighth-blocks above existing blocks (1 layer = 1, 1 snow block = 8). Example: 12 = up to 1 snow block + 4 layers. Existing blocks are never replaced.
Snow Tick Chance (%)
Chance per tick for a chunk to place or stack a snow layer.
Replace Short Grass & Flowers
Replaces short grass and small flowers with snow layers as snow falls.
Replace Small Mushrooms
Replaces red and brown mushrooms on the ground with snow layers.
Replace Tall Plants
Replaces tall flowers, sunflowers, and other double-tall plants with snow layers.
Biome Temperature
Sets the temperature for the specified biomes. Lower values enable snowfall in otherwise warmer areas.
Snow Biomes
List of biome IDs where snowfall is enabled.
Break Crops & Farmland
Removes growing crops and turns the farmland below into dirt, so snow can accumulate in crop fields.
Replace Dirt Paths
Replaces dirt paths with dirt when snow falls, so snow can remain on paths instead of sliding off.
Replace Torches
Removes torches on the ground (the item drops so you can pick it back up) and replaces them with snow layers.
Enable Powder Snow
Enables snow layers turning into powder snow.
Powder Snow Chance (%)
Chance (in percent) that a snow layer turns into powder snow.
